title: Higher direct images preserve coefficient-size filtered colimits
statement: Let $h:Y\to X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, and let $q\in\mathbf Z$. Let $J$ be a filtered small category. The functor $F\mapsto H^q(Rh_*(F[0]))=R^q h_*F$ on small-etale sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] preserves colimits of shape $J$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]: applying this functor to any colimit cocone gives a colimit cocone. Schemes live in universe $u$; the ring, coefficient modules, and objects and morphisms of $J$ live in universe $u+1$. No torsion hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0739 (lemma-colim-works-over-collection), 03Q8, and the fixed-scheme case of 09Z1 (lemma-relative-colimit)

proof.text: On any qcqs Z, compose nonempty_freeSheafDerivedSectionsIso and nonempty_etaleModuleCohomology_forgetIso. The underlying module-sheaf functor is a left adjoint by moduleSheafForgetIsLeftAdjoint, and etaleCohomology_isColimit_large_filtered proves continuity of abelian cohomology for Type(u+1) filtered indexing. Transport continuity through the composite natural isomorphism. For negative q the standard t-structure proves every shifted map from a degree-zero sheaf to a degree-zero sheaf zero, so the shifted-Hom functor preserves colimits.

For an affine etale W over X, its pullback Z along the qcqs h is qcqs by base-change permanence. Restriction to Z is a left adjoint on module sheaves. Compose it with shifted-Hom continuity from step 1 and transport through shiftedHomFunctorUpperStarFreeSheafIso. This gives continuity of each affine evaluation of the raw higher-image presheaf.

Use Mathlib preservesColimitsOfShape_of_evaluation to obtain continuity of the raw presheaf restricted along AffineEtale.Spec. Compose with affine-site sheafification, which preserves colimits. Mathlib Functor.IsDenseSubsite.sheafEquivSheafificationCompatibility identifies this composite with sheafification on the full small etale site followed by restriction of sheaves. That restriction is an equivalence (the dense-subsite sheafification adjunction), hence reflects colimits. Therefore the sheafified raw-presheaf functor preserves the same large filtered colimits.

The canonical raw-to-higher-image map induces an isomorphism from its sheafification, by isIso_higherDirectImagePresheafToSheaf_singleFunctor. These component isomorphisms are natural: transpose higherDirectImagePresheafToSheaf_naturality using Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_square. Thus the sheafified raw-presheaf functor is naturally isomorphic to higher direct image followed by coefficient forgetting. Transport preservation through this isomorphism. Coefficient forgetting is a left adjoint and reflects isomorphisms, so it reflects colimits; this proves preservation for higher direct image itself. No shrinking of the indexing universe is used.
